title: Google Business Profile
hint: Put your join link on your Google listing so people can join the line from Google Search and Maps.
step1: Open your Business Profile on Google (search for your business while signed in, or use business.google.com).
step2: Choose Edit profile, then Booking links (or Appointment link).
step3: Paste the link above and save.
step4: Google can take a few days to show it. Open the link on your phone to check that it works.
limits: Google's own "join waitlist" button needs Google's partner approval, which isn't available to us. This link shows as a booking or appointment button instead. People who join through it are counted as coming from Google.
